limitations: No individual GPS tracks: flights are interpolated between half-month seasonal distributions.
Reporting coverage is especially sparse in Siberia; effort correction reduces but cannot eliminate bias.
Species geographic masks isolate this regional flyway but do not identify individual populations or subspecies.
Empty smoothed half-months borrow the nearest observed half-month, explicitly listed per species in borrowedBins.
Dots have equal species weights for visibility and are not regional population estimates.
Three shorebirds use an explicitly illustrative breeding-range supplement in May-August; its geometry and blend fractions are not measured occupancy.

breedingRangeSupplement.method: A broad land-masked Gaussian breeding-range illustration is blended into normalized May-August observations for three shorebirds whose Siberian breeding grounds have sparse reports.
breedingRangeSupplement.interpretation: Species accounts support the broad region and season. Kernel geometry and mixture fractions are author-chosen illustration parameters, not measured occupancy, population fractions, GPS tracks, or new observations. Winter distributions and raw records are unchanged.
